guards: Credentials loaded privately through existing node env-file flags, no credential values printed, copied or written.
Only DATABASE_URL search_path and local process config adapted in memory.
No model or port is injected; global fetch observes actual OpenAI transport and blocks unexpected external traffic after counting attempts.
Require future watch deadline before each startup; otherwise stop and notify integrator.
First model request has exactly system+user, no memoryIDs or research refs/hashes; evidence must appear subsequently in actual tool messages.
Compare retrieved source native IDs/hashes, snapshot unchanged, no business proposal, witness has no observations.
Count actual OpenAI requests and research attempts separately; preserve real usage and timing in model_result traces.
A failed/lost run is retained; expected row counts refuse an automatic repeated model call.
Results remain candidate until both server reviews and final data receipt are received.
R2: Integrator reuses this same schema after R1; no competing environment.
